chunks.text: Welcome to the Slow English Podcast.
In this podcast, we speak very slowly.
Heidelberg is full of students and nature.
Germany is a country in Europe.
It is also a historic country.
Some cities are big and busy.
Some cities are calm and green.
Heidelberg is not very big, but it is very famous.
Heidelberg is in the southwest of Germany.
It is in a region called Baden -Württemberg.
The city is next to a river.
The river is called the Neckar River.
There are hills and forests nearby.
The city feels open and fresh.
In winter it can be cold.
Part 5 A city with long history.
People lived here many years ago.
The city was important in the past.
It was a center of learning and culture.
Many old buildings still stand today.
History is part of daily life.
When you walk in Heidelberg, you walk through time.
Heidelberg is famous for its castle.
The castle is on a hill.
Parts of it are in ruins.
People visit the castle every day.
The view from the top is amazing.
Part 7 The Old Town Heidelberg has a beautiful old town.
There are cafes and small stores.
The old town is the heart of the city.
It is called the Old Bridge.
It connects parts of the city.
They stop and look at the view.
The bridge is a symbol of Heidelberg.
Part 9 The University Heidelberg has a very famous university.
It is the oldest university in Germany.
They study science, medicine, and art.
Because of students, Heidelberg feels young and alive.
Daily life in Heidelberg is relaxed.
The city feels peaceful and safe.
Food in Heidelberg is simple and warm.
People eat bread, soup, and meat.
Students bring food from many cultures.
Nature is very close to Heidelberg.
Heidelberg is a city of history, students, nature, and calm life.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
See you in the next episode.
